answer_1.quote: We propose Assay2Mol to maximize the use of BioAssay records with LLMs. Given input such as protein target descriptions, phenotypic data, or other textual information, Assay2Mol retrieves relevant BioAssays and leverages in-context learning to generate molecules with the desired biological activity

answer_2.quote: We use Vina Dock to score the binding complementarity of a molecule, or the strength of interaction, with a protein target. High Affinity indicates the percentage of generated molecules that outperform the reference molecules in Vina Dock. Quantitative Estimate of Drug-likeness (QED) is a metric that combines multiple molecular properties... Synthetic Accessibility (SA) score estimates synthetic feasibility...

answer_3.quote: We use an LLM to determine whether the retrieved BioAssays are relevant to the query protein... We perform the manual assessment by reading through the assay description and abstract for each of the 10 retrieved AIDs for each target protein... and find that GPT 4o is fairly accurate in its relevance assessment but DeepSeek-V3 struggles

answer_4.quote: We perform the manual assessment by reading through the assay description and abstract for each of the 10 retrieved AIDs for each target protein... and confirm whether the assay readout would correspond with a biochemical interaction of the tested compounds with a protein of the same family as the target protein
answer_4.guideline: reading through the assay description and abstract for each of the 10 retrieved AIDs for each target protein and confirming whether the assay readout would correspond with a biochemical interaction of the tested compounds with a protein of the same family as the target protein. Also, where applicable we also confirmed the desired functional activity, inhibition or activation
